pay_detail: Unpaid. New volunteers pay a one-time $50 mission investment.
notes: The FAQ hopes to take juniors again soon, but the volunteer page still lists them. Email volunteer@columbushumane.org first.
name: Volunteer Program (teen volunteers ages 16 and 17)
what_you_do: Help care for shelter animals or help with non-animal tasks after training. Volunteers commit to at least 4 hours a month.
who_can_apply: Teens 16 and 17 can volunteer on their own. A guardian must sign a Junior and Teen Volunteer Waiver and Release. Ages 12 to 15 can join only as junior volunteers, with an adult volunteer partner over the age of 21. The FAQ says only ages 16 and up for now.
deadline_text: The page gives no registration deadline and does not say when sign-ups open.
how_to_apply: Fill out the New Volunteer Registration form. Then use the emailed link to book an in-person STEPS orientation in Hilliard. Next, finish species training and mentoring. Then start to book shifts.
